page.layout: One printed page: one column of running text, with Greek and Latin in the same paragraph. No marginal notes. Page number at the head. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: est: sed eos quoque, qui sibi mendaciter Apocrisiariorum nomen vsurpauerant, & aduersus hunc sanctum virum iniqua peregere, eos ha sanctissimae sedes reiectos anathemate tradiderunt. Similia continet Epistola Theodosij Patriarchae lecta Act. 4. Et ne dicas, effata ista esse singularia, & paucorum Episcoporum assumenta, qui separati ab vnione Romanae Ecclesiae talia obloquuntur, sed Synodum vniuersam Ioanni Pontifici vnitam alia sensisse, suam ipsa Synodus sententiam profert at. Actione 4. [?]Ἡ μὲν ἡμᾶς καὶ σὲ τῆς ἐπιστολῆς ταύτης[?] Patriarchae nempe Hierosolymitani, [?]ἀ μόνου δὲ ταύτης, ἀλλὰ καὶ σὲ τῆς ἐλθούσης δι᾽ Ἀνδρέου[?], ἧς ἐμαρτύρησεν[?] πᾶσαν ἐχομένην πληροφορίαν[?], ὅτι ἐδίκαιον διέσπα[?] οἱ ἀποστολικοὶ[?] ἐγνώσθη[?] Παζιαρχου[?], ἀλλ᾽ ἀεὶ καὶ συναρχικὰ[?], καὶ συλλήπτορον ἄχθος[?], καὶ ἀνικήτου[?]. Nos etiam non ante hanc Epistolam solum, sed ante eam quoq; quae per Andream missa est, & paulo ante lecta, satis certi sumus, nunquam Orientales Sedes a sanctissimo nostro Patriarcha sese separasse, sed continuo & coepiscopum, & comministrum habuisse, & praedicasse. Concludamus ergo hanc Synodum etiamsi vere coacta fuisset, nullam vim in Ecclesia obtinere, sed modis omnibus ex aliorum numero reijciendam, expungendamque fuisse.

page.notes: The Greek sentences are only partly legible on the scan; the Greek words marked [?] are best readings and need checking against the original. The Greek in the first sentence of the Actione 4 passage is uncertain throughout. Printed spelling kept as it appears, including "ha" for "hae", "comministrum", "Parriarchae" and "Apocrisiariorum". Catchword "Ar-" at lower right. Small reading marks in the image are not transcribed.
